minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: variable.t = query.day + query.time_of_day; variable.lm = (variable.t - 80) / 365.25 * 360; variable.me = (variable.t - 3) / 365.25 * 360; variable.ls = variable.lm + 1.915 * math.sin(variable.me) + 0.02 * math.sin(2 * variable.me); variable.lmoon = variable.lm + variable.t / 29.53 * 360 + 180 + 6.29 * math.sin(variable.t / 27.55 * 360); variable.bmoon = 5.145 * math.sin(variable.lmoon - (101.1 - variable.t / 6793.5 * 360)); variable.d = variable.lmoon - variable.ls; variable.dwrap = math.atan2(math.sin(variable.d), math.cos(variable.d)); variable.elong = math.mod(variable.dwrap + 360, 360); variable.raw_idx = math.floor(math.mod(variable.elong + 22.5, 360) / 45); variable.phase = math.mod(variable.raw_idx + 4, 8); variable.dl = math.atan2(math.sin(variable.d - 180), math.cos(variable.d - 180)); variable.ecl_d = math.sqrt(math.pow(variable.dl / 3.0, 2) + math.pow(variable.bmoon, 2)); variable.blood_intensity = math.clamp((0.96 - variable.ecl_d) / 0.52, 0, 1); variable.par = query.position(2) / 63710 * 2.9; variable.sep = math.sqrt(math.pow(variable.dwrap, 2) + math.pow(variable.bmoon + variable.par, 2)); variable.eclipse = math.clamp((1.2 - variable.sep) / 0.7, 0, 1); variable.day_alpha = math.lerp(1.0, 0.5, math.clamp(math.sin(query.time_of_day * 360), 0, 1));
